Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Scrap and Munitions tokens.

Resolve the Metalwork Colossus ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.

When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it

3101-3292-3892-4785.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
3101-3292-3892-4785.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3101-3292-3892-4785.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Xenograft, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.

1021-4050-5411-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-4050-5411-6761.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {1}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-4050-5411-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

Basking Broodscale triggers, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.

997-4484-4871-4924-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
997-4484-4871-4924-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
997-4484-4871-4924-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.
